<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/plugin-api/ai/providers/{id}/context"}

For the provider's default model, every model with an override, every model the user has called through it, and any named in models. source is override, provider (reported by the provider), guess (from the model's family) or default (128k). refresh asks the provider again instead of using what it said in the last six hours.
